title: Functional Capacity and Quality of Life in Patients With Vascular Ring
brief_summary: To investigate the long term functional capacity and quality of life of patients with a history of vascular ring whether they did or did not have corrective surgery. Patients will perform pulmonary function test, 6 minute walk test, cardiopulmonary exercise test and will fill a quality of life questionnaire.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* patients with history of vascular ring

Exclusion Criteria:

* refusal to participate
* inability to complete cardiopulmonary testing
study_population: patients with history of vascualr ring
